recommended_wording: UGO-Omics provides a cross-species, evolution-informed discovery platform for underground-organ biology.
avoid_wording: UGO-Omics proves the evolutionary origin of underground organs.
reason: Platform and discovery framework are supported; definitive origin reconstruction is not.

recommended_wording: UGO-Omics identifies candidate signals consistent with recurrent recruitment of a regeneration–resilience toolkit.
avoid_wording: UGO-Omics demonstrates repeated causal deployment of the same genes.
reason: Module recurrence supports hypothesis generation, not functional validation.

recommended_wording: The 11-species BUSCO tree provides an independent phylogenetic context for interpreting module recurrence.
avoid_wording: The BUSCO tree reconstructs the definitive evolutionary history of underground organs.
reason: Tree is a context framework, not an ancestral-state reconstruction.

recommended_wording: The known-category benchmark supports the credibility of module-level candidate prioritization.
avoid_wording: The benchmark validates the function of individual genes.
reason: Benchmark is category/module-level, not experimental validation.

recommended_wording: Functional testing will be required to determine the roles of individual candidate genes.
avoid_wording: The prioritized genes are validated regulators.
